title: The comment-narration check passes a "round N" that names a rule
why: lint/check_comment_narration.py flags "round 3" and "after round 3" in a comment that states a rule, such as "a passing fix keeps the net value round 3 gave", which quotes decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 (net-value hold after round 3). Lane fail-record-ancestor-head reworded around it on #1829 at 016dfb24a (that lane, 02:05 CST; coordinator, 01:49 CST Nov 8). A guard false alarm (rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent).
note: Fix: a "round N" that names a rule or decision passes; a "round N" that tells history is still flagged. Red case first on the example line; control: a history line such as "fixed in round 2" stays flagged. Starts after lane comment-check-scans-shell merges (same file). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the coordinator. Filed 02:19 CST Nov 8. Built with the other of comment-shell-round2-fixes / narration-check-rule-quotes as one follow-up PR from #1834's head, in lane session_013NEJL37UFXTQuAcox7s8fD (coordinator, 02:05 CST Nov 8). Scope narrowed (lane, #1840; coordinator approved 02:43 CST Nov 8): only a "round N" inside the gloss attached to a real decision id passes, such as "(decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3, net-value hold after round 3)". The prose example in the why, "a passing fix keeps the net value round 3 gave", stays flagged; rewording clears it.
